causal_source_chain.finding: Every column-zero ## heading splits a section. parse_sections stores lowercased heading->stripped text, not raw order/unknown sections. Notes ends at the first custom ## heading; duplicate headings overwrite dictionary entries.

read_experiment sets notes only from sec.get("notes", ""). Experiment has no raw-body/custom-section preservation field. Later headings are not incorporated into notes. This happens even though write_experiment originally accepted arbitrary multiline notes.

interpret_experiment reads the truncated Experiment, replaces its interpretation, then rewrites the entire canonical body. Only e.notes is emitted at Notes; unknown custom sections are absent. The retained failure diff matches this exact mechanism.

Canonical serialization overwrites the whole file via write_text. It does not patch just Interpretation or preserve unmodelled body bytes. The module docstring claim of lossless round-trip is false for this heading layout.

api_audit.disposition: No notes parameter; reads truncated notes; rewriting repeats defect. Repeating also constructs a fresh Interpretation, whose at defaults to now_iso, so it cannot preserve the new interpretation byte-for-byte.

Only normal closed-record route accepting notes, but recomputes observed effects, prediction match, verdict and recipe_fingerprint; propagates and writes hypothesis status. Explicitly forbidden, even if a recomputation might coincidentally agree.
Reject closed records. They are not restoration APIs.
Whitelisted provenance only; accepts no notes restoration. It changes provenance/report_path and invokes the same lossy writer.
Creates a new Experiment, not a notes amendment. Reusing an explicit ID would overwrite recorded experiment state; prohibited.
No experiment notes amendment; changes unrelated state. No generic raw-experiment update tool is registered.
Rebuilds only disposable SQLite from existing Markdown through current parser. It cannot restore already deleted text and still reads truncated notes.
Internal Python methods, not registered MCP tools. Direct use would bypass the required Client write path; not an existing authorized workaround.

approval_only_minimal_recovery_proposal.inputs: Allowlist only the two targets and exact RESTORATION_CANDIDATES_V1.json entries: bad-current SHA256, candidate path/SHA256/size; also bind BEFORE_SNAPSHOT_V1.json.gz and original per-document hashes. approval_only_minimal_recovery_proposal.construction: Use the already prepared hash-bound candidate bytes, not regenerated Experiment serialization. Verify the delta from expected current bytes is exactly the approved single insertion of snapshot text within the Notes tail. Independently require unchanged whole frontmatter and preceding Interpretation, and original body outside Interpretation restored. Preserve whitespace and footer. Never call write_experiment, close_experiment or interpret_experiment.
approval_only_minimal_recovery_proposal.preconditions: Preflight both targets before any write. Verify source/snapshot/current/candidate hashes, exact regular-file paths, unique Notes boundaries and closed state. Require candidate frontmatter/current Interpretation (including at), all gates/measurements/status/fingerprint and other fields unchanged; body outside Interpretation equals original under the declared comparison convention. Reject ambiguous boundaries, changed footer or unexpected drift.
approval_only_minimal_recovery_proposal.write_discipline: Only after approval and in-memory validation: acquire exclusive same-vault access, ensure no other Store/MCP process, compare expected current bytes immediately before each atomic same-directory replacement, fsync file/directory, retain both old snapshots and damaged copies. Account peak temporary writes. Record each target separately; two replacements are not one atomic transaction, so any partial completion remains explicit and stop-on-failure.
approval_only_minimal_recovery_proposal.receipt: Return actual target path, before/snapshot/after SHA256, exact-byte invariants and explicit success. Parent validates semantic receipt plus raw readback. Idempotent retry is allowed only for exact expected-after bytes; it must not advance interpretation timestamps. No hypothesis or foreign-vault write; no science calls.
approval_only_minimal_recovery_proposal.no_shortcut: A direct ad-hoc vault edit, global monkeypatch, reclose, prose insertion into lesson/provenance, or fresh interpret call is NOT authorized by this proposal.

separate_prevention_fix_for_approval.need: One-time byte restoration does not cure the installed parser. Any later ordinary writer touching these records can erase their custom sections again. Freeze further rewrites until a reviewed preservation fix is installed or an approved safe route is used.
separate_prevention_fix_for_approval.bounded_option: In a separately approved versioned server copy, change experiment-specific notes reading to retain the complete raw Notes tail after the unique Notes header through the generated final tag footer, including all ## custom headings (even a nested-in-notes ## Provenance). Do not change the generic section splitter for every entity. Preserve the existing whole raw tail on interpretation-only writes for exact byte-level protection; a naive join of parsed sections loses headings/order/blank lines.
separate_prevention_fix_for_approval.limits: Tail capture works for the canonical writer layout, where Notes is last before tags; reject or explicitly handle noncanonical later reserved sections and heading-like code fences. Do not silently absorb unrelated structured sections. A parser-only patch cannot reconstruct text already lost in the two current files. This prevention change needs its own approval/tests and is not part of any claimed completed repair.

prospective_validation_not_run: Use disposable fixture vaults only, containing exact before/bad-after documents plus no-extra-heading and custom-Provenance/repeated-heading/ambiguous-boundary cases. No science imports or model work.

Fixture repair must reproduce approved candidate bytes; stale/snapshot/hash/metadata/timestamp drift must fail closed. Repeated repair must be a no-op; no reclose/verdict/fingerprint/status code may execute.
Fixture interpretation update on restored documents must preserve all custom Notes bytes with the separately proposed prevention fix; unmodified installed writer is expected to remain unsafe.
